title: THE CAPTAIN'S CALL — the one-line card deck
_why: This is the ONE lane that may ask him for anything (his 7 Aug ruling: max one card per anchor). A malformed card is a question he can never answer, and by his 11 Aug ruling anything he must chase is a bug in the organism.
